questions.question: Work out 345 times 8 by breaking 345 into hundreds, tens and units.
questions.expected_answer: 300 times 8 is 2 400, 40 times 8 is 320 and 5 times 8 is 40. 2 400 plus 320 plus 40 is 2 760.

questions.question: Use the grid method to work out 126 times 35.
questions.expected_answer: Split 126 into 100, 20 and 6, and 35 into 30 and 5. The six products are 3 000, 600, 180, 500, 100 and 30. They add up to 4 410.

questions.question: Work out 144 times 24 by long multiplication and explain the zero in the second row.
questions.expected_answer: 144 times 4 is 576. For 144 times 20, write a 0 first because we are multiplying by 2 tens, then 144 times 2 gives 2 880. 576 plus 2 880 is 3 456.
